records.title: SplitQuant: Resource-Efficient LLM Offline Serving on Heterogeneous GPUs via Phase-Aware Model Partition and Adaptive Quantization
records.reason: SplitQuant targets heterogeneous-GPU offline LLM serving with phase-aware model partition and adaptive quantization. The author-hosted paper is the primary conference manuscript.

records.title: EMPIRIC: Exploring Missing Pieces in KV Cache Compression for Reducing Computation, Storage, and Latency in Long-Context LLM Inference
records.reason: EMPIRIC analyzes KV-cache compression tradeoffs in LLM inference across computation, storage, and latency; the ACM publisher abstract is available.

records.title: ELUTQ: Efficient LUT-Aware Quantization for Deploying Large Language Models on Edge Devices
records.reason: ELUTQ designs LUT-aware low-bit quantization and CPU kernels for edge LLM inference, directly addressing memory and latency constraints.

records.title: Turning LLM Activations Quantization-Friendly
records.reason: The primary abstract examines LLM activation outliers and proposes a scaling-before-rotation method to enable integer quantization and lower serving costs.

records.title: Accelerating Large Language Model Inference with Self-Supervised Early Exits
records.reason: Self-supervised early-exit heads conditionally stop LLM computation based on confidence, directly reducing inference time while preserving accuracy.

records.title: Leveraging Sparsity for Efficient Inference of High-Resolution Vision Foundation Models
records.reason: The primary BMVC paper accelerates high-resolution vision encoders (DINOv2, CLIP, SAM2); it is an independent vision application, not the target LLM systems scope.

records.title: CPET: Effective Parameter-Efficient Tuning for Compressed Large Language Models
records.reason: CPET studies parameter-efficient tuning on compressed LLM backbones and explicitly seeks better inference efficiency for serving multiple task modules.

records.title: Memory-Efficient Generative Models via Product Quantization
records.reason: Product quantization compresses diffusion image-generation models; the primary abstract’s main target is image generation, outside the independent-vision-application exclusion boundary.

records.title: APCE: Adaptive Progressive Context Expansion for Long Context Processing
records.reason: APCE selects relevant input chunks for long-context processing, reducing KV-cache and self-attention memory on summarization workloads.
